name: Comms Edge
job: Handles inbound IVR calls to +18663444955 and the two chat widgets. Does not create Sales opportunities.

named_steps.name: TRIGGER: IVR +18663444955 or chat widget inbound
named_steps.comment: Sole entry for IVR + chat. Must not create a Sales opportunity here.

named_steps.name: IF-ELSE: Branch on channel (IVR | chat)
named_steps.comment: Splits IVR vs chat paths for tagging and copy.

named_steps.name: ADD-TAG: v2_source_ivr (IVR branch)
named_steps.comment: New v2 source tag for IVR.

named_steps.name: ADD-TAG: v2_source_chat (chat branch)
named_steps.comment: New v2 source tag for chat widgets.

named_steps.name: SMS: IVR callback ack (inline, IVR branch)
named_steps.comment: Inline SMS. Honors quiet hours 8am-9pm contact TZ.

named_steps.name: EMAIL: Chat follow-up (native template, chat branch)
IF-ELSE: New contact vs existing contact
named_steps.comment: Existing contacts stay on their current opp. New contacts route to WF-01 to enroll properly.

named_steps.name: ADD-TO-WF: New contact re-enters WF-01
named_steps.comment: New contacts route to WF-01 for create-once Sales opp. Must not create Sales opps here.
